## Allen Coral Atlas

``` bash
//Workshop 4

//Step 1 Global Variables
var distance = 800 // metres we are allowed to snorkel from the station

//Step 2 research station locations

//Heron Island
Map.setCenter(151.91400746, -23.44100605, 15);

//Hamilton Island
//Map.setCenter(148.95757924, -20.34639327, 24);

//Lizard Island
//Map.setCenter(145.44647541, -14.66767257, 24);

//Daydream Island
//Map.setCenter(148.81555647, -20.25161732, 24);

//Orpheus Island
//Map.setCenter(146.49992691, -18.63411616, 24);

//HIMB, Kane'ohe bay, hawaii
//Map.setCenter(-157.7915, 21.4377, 24)

//ICAR-CIARI / Fisheries Research Station (Minicoy Atoll, Lakshadweep)
//Map.setCenter( 73.0479, 8.3022, 24)

//Koh Tao/New Heaven Coral Reef Research Center
//Map.setCenter( 99.8509, 10.1017, 24)

//Phuket Marine Biological Center (PMBC)
//Map.setCenter( 98.41261, 7.79527 , 24)

//now build feature collection
var field_stations = ee.FeatureCollection([Heron, Orpheus, Lizard, Hamilton, Daydream, Orpheus, Kaneohe, KohTao, Minicoy, Phuket])
print (field_stations.first())

// Importing ACA data
var allenCoral = ee.Image("ACA/reef_habitat/v2_0")
print(allenCoral)
//Map.addLayer(allenCoral)

// Selecting only the benthic band
var allenBenthic = allenCoral.select("benthic")
print(allenBenthic)

//further filtering the benthic band to algae and coral
var coralAlgae = allenBenthic.eq(15).selfMask()
print(coralAlgae)
//Map.addLayer(coralAlgae)
Map.addLayer(coralAlgae, {palette:['pink', 'green']}, 'coral and algae')

//test buffer on one field station
//var buffered = ee.Feature(field_stations.first()).buffer(distance)// buffers only one feature.
//Map.addLayer(buffered)

//now lets make a function that operates as a for loop, buffering everything in our feature collection
// write a function that applies a buffer
// To run as a .map - looping over all stations - we will need to make a function
var bufferer = function (feature) {
  var buffered = feature.buffer(distance)
  return buffered;
}
// Use .map to work one station at a time
var bufferedStations = field_stations.map(bufferer) 
print(bufferedStations, 'buffered stations')
Map.addLayer(bufferedStations, {color:'yellow'}, 'buffered')

// Lets calculate the area of coral within the buffered regions
// Compute area of coral within buffer
var coral_area = coralAlgae // binary 1 == coral
  .multiply (ee.Image.pixelArea()) // get the area of each pixel
  .reduceRegions({
  reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), // sum all pixel areas together
  collection: bufferedStations,
  scale:5 
})
// Check it out using addLayer and print- view the area of coral within each buffer
print(coral_area, 'coral area')
print (coral_area.sort('sum', false)) //The research station at phuket has the most coral with 561786m2 of coral cover, Daydream island has the least at 36576m2
Map.addLayer(coral_area, {color:'pink'}, 'area of coral within buffer')

// now lets export this to google drive
// Export.table.toDrive({
//   collection: coral_area, //FYI - type: featureCollection
//   description: 'exportToDrive',
//   fileNamePrefix: 'research_stations_MB370',
//   fileFormat:'CSV'
// })


var exportImage = coralAlgae.clip(coral_area)
Map.addLayer(exportImage)


// Get the buffer geometry for Phuket
var phuketGeometry = Phuket.buffer(distance).geometry();

// Clip image to Phuket buffer
var exportImage = coralAlgae.clip(phuketGeometry);
Map.addLayer(exportImage, {}, 'Phuket Coral');

// Export to Google Drive
// Export.image.toDrive({

//   description: 'exportImage_Phuket',
//   fileNamePrefix: 'aca_phuket',
//   region: phuketGeometry,
//   fileFormat: 'GeoTIFF',
//   scale: 5
// });
```
